component.name: DLNA SERVER
component.summary: Share local video folders with DLNA-compatible TVs and devices

description.p: DLNA SERVER is a desktop application for streaming local video libraries over a home network to DLNA-compatible Smart TVs, mobile devices, and media players.

ul.li: Automatically discovers compatible devices on the local network.
Streams supported video files directly with HTTP range requests.
Can transcode unsupported video formats to H.264/AAC, with hardware acceleration when available.
Provides a system tray interface and optional autostart.
